name: Metavesco, Inc.
summary: Metavesco is a diversified holding company focused on acquiring and managing assets across multiple sectors, including consumer packaged goods and staffing services. The company is dedicated to long-term growth through strategic acquisitions and innovative market solutions. Through its Epic Labor subsidiary, Metavesco provides on-demand blue-collar staffing for various industries. The company also operates in the digital asset space, including Bitcoin mining and the development of the OTCfi ecosystem.
